representative_path_policy: Only versioned, source-bounded partial examples are considered; never assert original full playable game from a tested local model.

priority_choice.reason: The authenticated v1 client already supplies protocol-visible UI/state and complete indexed resource provenance, while unresolved 1999 commercial server-only task/reward schema cannot be safely invented. A five-surface finite crosswalk can improve original-facing game specifications without selecting an engine.
priority_choice.work_scope: five v1 protocol/status/widget/asset semantic crosswalk cells; existing evidence first; targeted exact source where required, not full binary helper exhaustion.
priority_choice.stop: Produce source-role/visible state/input-action/asset reference/unknown table for exactly five surfaces; if original renderer mapping remains unavailable, record OPEN with material impact rather than invent a screen.

explicit_no_promotions: A contemporary original client does not contain original commercial server maps/quests/values by itself.
Recovered25 four-hometown routes do not become JSS1999/TW1.0 content.
Local shop/pet/battle/save deterministic tests do not establish original server behavior.
A parser/widget naming placeholder does not establish a functioning original UI action.
Resource presence and ID-space are not themselves a proven onscreen resource selection.
No material percentage can be inferred from test count, file count or historical R index.
